result.title: Spatially local mini-batching for implicit neural representations
result.summary: Neural surrogates based on implicit neural representations (INRs) are typically trained on mini-batches spread over the whole domain, since a generic INR loses accuracy when every point of a batch lies in one small region. We show that low-rank neural representations (LRNRs), INRs whose weight matrices are products of shared bases with coefficients emitted by a small hypernetwork, can be trained with spatially local mini-batches. Each step uses the points of one time snapshot of an adaptive-mesh numerical solution inside one small cell, with snapshots and cells drawn according to the refinement of the mesh. We posit that such training is enabled by the structural property of LRNRs, as a local step reaches the shared bases only through the $r$ coefficients of each layer, and keeps one cell from rewriting the network. By a Kolmogorov-width argument, we show that when restricted to a small cell, the hidden states of LRNRs lie close to a low-dimensional subspace, which suggests the local steps only affect low-rank subspaces of the shared bases. On six hyperbolic-conservation-law problems with solutions computed using adaptive mesh refinement, one local training recipe reaches 1.1-2.3% relative $L^2$ error with a tenth of the parameters of a dense network of the same width. Finally, we provide a comparison by training a hypernetwork-SIREN, a DeepONet, and a Fourier neural operator (FNO) of the same size with the same local batches and training budget. We observe that these baselines reach 16-78% where the LRNR reaches 4.9%. Interestingly, we also observe that local training has a significant effect on the per-cell low-dimensional structure even in a wide generic hypernetwork-SIREN.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究低秩隐式神经表示（LRNR，由共享基与小型超网络输出的系数相乘构成）能否改用空间局部 mini-batch 训练，每步只取自适应网格单个单元内的快照点，并以 Kolmogorov 宽度论证局部隐状态落在低维子空间，在六个双曲守恒律问题上报告精度与参数效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享基＋每层少量系数」使局部更新仅经由低维子空间触及共享基的结构，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的局部更新、避免单步更新改写共享表示提供核查线索；但研究对象是 PDE 代理建模，与视觉推理无直接证据。
